placement.method: Seven thin facade sections fitted to source walls at multiple widths/heights; 0.16 m outward offset. Original source roofs constrain all wall finishes. This corrects the earlier generic Dave/Madame nameplates to mapped tenant order.

details: Large shallow blue/orange oval Dave & Buster’s sign, metal rims and brackets
Two-sided EAT / DRINK / PLAY / WATCH projecting blade
Bronze/red glazed frontage, glass doors and Liberty Diner canopy lettering
Gold/violet segmented Madame Tussauds blade on gold supports
Curved stainless canopy with red soffit, red entrance portal and branded medallion
Authored fixed silver hand sculpture with shaped palm, four fingers, thumb, joints and nails
Six panels from existing fictional movie/retail atlases
Extended south sidewalk and curb, eight concrete barriers and two stainless bollards
Visit shortcut and phone-map pins for both attractions
scope: Exterior-only scenery in the existing Times Square city section. Original NYC tiles unchanged. No new characters, interiors, vehicles or gameplay systems.
approximations: Facade dimensions, sign proportions, canopy profile, sculpture and lighting are authored interpretations of the photographs, not a surveyed or photographic reconstruction.
The Madame Tussauds hand is a simplified static sculpture.
Liberty Diner finish follows the supplied historic photo reference; it does not assert current operating tenants.
Advertising reuses fictional scenery rather than current attraction promotions.
Roof/wall shapes follow the historical NYC dataset, which can differ from present-day buildings.
verification: Multi-height source wall fitting, walking/running both directions with surrounding city/street/landmark obstacles, visit spawn and doorway access, concrete/stainless obstacle collision, under-canopy camera clearance, real Cesium Primitive/Material construction, native Canvas drawing and production build. Browser/WebGL visual QA and live FPS measurements unavailable.
